summary.name: Django Chat
summary.one_liner: A biweekly podcast about the Django web framework, hosted by Will Vincent and Carlton Gibson.
use_cases: Keeping up with Django community news
Listening to interviews with Django developers
Learning about the Django Developers Survey results
Finding discussion on Django, HTMX and async
Hearing about Python hiring and conferences
summary.what_it_does: This is a podcast page about the Django web framework, published every two weeks by Will Vincent and Carlton Gibson. The visible episode listings include an interview with a software engineer working on ESA's NewAthena mission, a conversation with a recruiter focused on Python and Django developers, and a special summer episode covering the 2026 Django Developers Survey. The survey episode topics named include Django 6.1, HTMX, async, AI, deployment, testing and Python tooling. The page text is mostly episode teasers and cookie banner text, so little else is stated.
notable: Hosted by Django core contributor Carlton Gibson and Will Vincent
Special episode covering the 2026 Django Developers Survey
caveats: Page text shows only episode teasers; no pricing or subscription details are stated
Episode list visible here is partial
